# ExpressiveCSS component decisions

Pick the row that matches the job and read its guide. Compare alternatives only when the fit is ambiguous.

| Component | Use when | Avoid when | Alternatives | Runtime |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [App bar](../components/app-bar.md) | Page title and screen-level actions. | Peer destinations need navigation; categories need tabs. | `navigation-bar`, `tabs`, `breadcrumbs` | auto-init |
| [Navigation bar](../components/navigation-bar.md) | Persistent peer destinations on compact screens. | Commands need buttons; local panels need tabs. | `navigation-rail`, `toolbars` | css-only |
| [Navigation rail](../components/navigation-rail.md) | Collapsed, expanded, or modal peer navigation; the Expressive drawer replacement. | Compact peers fit a navigation bar; verify nesting support. | `navigation-bar` | auto-init |
| [Panes](../components/panes.md) | Responsive list-detail or supporting layouts. | A single collection needs a list, not multiple panes. | `lists` | css-only |
| [Footer](../components/footer.md) | Site links and legal information at page end. | Primary app destinations need persistent navigation. | `navigation-bar` | css-only |
| [Tabs](../components/tabs.md) | Switch related content panels within one page. | App destinations need navigation; values need inputs. | `navigation-bar`, `button-groups` | auto-init |
| [Breadcrumbs](../components/breadcrumbs.md) | Ancestor path to the current page. | Peer views need tabs; numbered results need pagination. | `tabs`, `pagination` | css-only |
| [Pagination](../components/pagination.md) | Move through pages of one result set. | In-page sections need anchors or scrollspy. | `scrollspy` | css-only |
| [Stepper](../components/stepper.md) | Show progress through a fixed order of steps the user completes one after another. | Views people switch between freely need tabs; one task with a percentage needs a progress indicator. | `tabs`, `progress`, `breadcrumbs`, `timeline`, `questionnaire` | css-only |
| [Menu](../components/menu.md) | Pick one action or option from a list opened by a control. | The choices need persistent layout space, blocking interaction, or peer navigation. | `bottom-sheet`, `side-sheet`, `navigation-rail` | auto-init |
| [Scrollspy](../components/scrollspy.md) | Track visible sections in a table of contents. | Separate views need navigation or tabs. | `tabs`, `navigation-bar` | auto-init |
| [Tree](../components/tree.md) | Browse a hierarchy several levels deep, such as files or nested sections, with branches that open in place. | One or two levels of navigation need a navigation rail or a list; peer sections need tabs. | `lists`, `navigation-rail`, `accordion` | native |
| [Buttons](../components/buttons.md) | Run an action with a visible label. | Stored choices need inputs; destinations need links. | `button-groups`, `icon-buttons` | css-only |
| [Icon buttons](../components/icon-buttons.md) | Compact actions with recognizable icons. | An unfamiliar action needs a visible button label. | `buttons`, `tooltips` | css-only |
| [Button groups](../components/button-groups.md) | Cluster commands or aria-pressed toggle buttons. | Submitted values need segmented or other native inputs. | `split-button`, `radio-buttons` | auto-init |
| [Split button](../components/split-button.md) | Default action plus related menu actions. | Equal actions need a group; values need inputs. | `button-groups`, `menu` | auto-init |
| [Floating action button](../components/fab.md) | One primary action or a FAB menu of related labelled actions.; Replace removed speed dials with fab-menu and labelled actions. | The action is not the single highest-priority screen action. | `buttons`, `toolbars` | auto-init |
| [Cards](../components/cards.md) | Distinct items with their own content or actions. | Dense comparable rows need a list. | `lists`, `carousel`, `badges` | auto-init |
| [Aura](../components/aura.md) | Draw the eye to the single most important button, card or panel on a screen, such as a recommended plan. | Several highlighted items compete for attention; state, status or selection needs a badge, chip or the component's own selected style. | `badges`, `cards`, `buttons` | css-only |
| [Lists](../components/lists.md) | Scan repeated rows of text and images. | Rich independent items need cards. | `cards`, `carousel`, `panes` | css-only |
| [Message](../components/message.md) | Show a conversation as messages from people or an assistant, aligned by sender. | Short app feedback needs a snackbar; a list of conversations needs a list. | `snackbar`, `lists`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Message scroller](../components/message-scroller.md) | Scroll a conversation that receives messages or streamed replies, or open a saved transcript at its last turn. | A short static exchange needs no scroller; a feed of unrelated items needs a list or the scroll-area utility. | `message`, `lists` | auto-init |
| [Accordion](../components/accordion.md) | Let people open one of several labelled sections on demand, such as FAQs or grouped settings. | Peer views of equal weight need tabs; content everyone must read should stay visible. | `tabs`, `lists`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Data table](../components/data-table.md) | Compare many records across the same columns, with sorting or selecting rows. | A few rows of reference data need only the table styles; items people scan by title need a list. | `lists`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Stat](../components/stat.md) | Summarize a few key figures, each with a label and an optional change, at the top of a dashboard. | Many rows of comparable records need a data table; a trend over time needs a chart. | `data-table`, `cards`, `kpi` | css-only |
| [KPI](../components/kpi.md) | Feature a headline figure on a dashboard with its change, a short trend and a line of context or an action. | Several figures with no chart or actions read better as a stats row; a trend the reader has to inspect needs a full chart. | `stat`, `line-chart`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Countdown](../components/countdown.md) | Show a small whole number that changes in place, such as seconds left, a clock or a live count, and draw the eye to each change. | A labelled key figure needs a stat tile; progress toward a goal needs a progress indicator; numbers above 999 or with decimals need plain text. | `stat`, `progress`, `badges` | css-only |
| [Line chart](../components/line-chart.md) | Show how one or a few measures change over an ordered axis such as months or days, with exact values a hover or a key press away. | Readers need to compare exact values across many rows or sort them; use a data table. A single headline figure needs a stat tile, optionally with a sparkline. | `column-chart`, `data-table`, `stat`, `mixed-chart` | auto-init |
| [Column chart](../components/column-chart.md) | Compare amounts across a handful of categories or periods, such as revenue per month or signups per plan, where the reader judges heights against zero. | The point is the trend's shape over many periods; use a line chart. Readers need exact values across many rows or sorting; use a data table. A single headline figure needs a stat tile. | `bar-chart`, `line-chart`, `data-table`, `stat`, `mixed-chart` | auto-init |
| [Bar chart](../components/bar-chart.md) | Compare amounts across categories with long labels or a ranked order, such as visitors by source, or show one total split into parts against a limit. | The categories are periods; use a column chart, or a line chart for a trend. Readers need exact values across many rows or sorting; use a data table. | `column-chart`, `line-chart`, `data-table`, `stat`, `pie-chart` | auto-init |
| [Pie chart](../components/pie-chart.md) | Show how one total splits into a few parts, such as revenue by plan or leads by source, when the shares matter more than exact differences. | There are more than about five parts or the parts are close in size; use a bar chart. The values do not add up to a meaningful whole, or change over time; use a column or line chart. | `bar-chart`, `column-chart`, `data-table`, `stat`, `radial-chart` | auto-init |
| [Heatmap chart](../components/heatmap-chart.md) | Show where values run high or low across two categories, such as visits by day and hour or activity by week, when the pattern matters more than exact values. | Readers need to compare exact values, or one category has a single row; use a data table or a bar chart. Values change over a continuous time series; use a line chart. | `data-table`, `bar-chart`, `column-chart`, `line-chart` | auto-init |
| [Radar chart](../components/radar-chart.md) | Compare a profile of five to eight measures that share one scale, such as skill or satisfaction scores, for one or a few subjects. | The measures use different units or scales, exact differences matter, or there are more than three series; use a bar or column chart. The rows are a sequence such as months; use a line chart. | `bar-chart`, `column-chart`, `line-chart`, `data-table` | auto-init |
| [Radial chart](../components/radial-chart.md) | Show how far one to four measures are toward a goal or limit, such as plan targets, capacity or a score. | The values are parts of one whole; use a pie chart. More than about four measures, or close comparisons, need a bar chart. A running task's progress needs a progress indicator. | `pie-chart`, `bar-chart`, `progress`, `stat` | auto-init |
| [Mixed chart](../components/mixed-chart.md) | Compare a measure with a target or a related measure on the same rows, such as revenue against a target line or spend against conversions. | Every series is the same kind; use a line or column chart. Two scales on one plot invite false comparisons, so when the series are unrelated, draw two charts. | `line-chart`, `column-chart`, `data-table` | auto-init |
| [Timeline](../components/timeline.md) | Show what happened and when, in order, such as order tracking or an activity feed. | Steps the user still has to complete need a stepper; a live conversation needs messages. | `stepper`, `lists`, `message` | css-only |
| [Dialogs](../components/dialogs.md) | Focused prompts or decisions that interrupt the flow. | Ignorable feedback needs snackbar or inline feedback. | `snackbar`, `bottom-sheet`, `side-sheet` | shared-runtime |
| [Bottom sheet](../components/bottom-sheet.md) | Secondary content anchored to the bottom of the screen. | Persistent wider-window secondary content or a small anchored choice fits another component. | `side-sheet`, `menu`, `dialogs` | shared-runtime |
| [Side sheet](../components/side-sheet.md) | Optional content and actions, without interrupting the main view. | The content is peer navigation or requires a blocking modal decision. | `navigation-rail`, `bottom-sheet`, `dialogs` | shared-runtime |
| [Drag handle](../components/drag-handle.md) | The bar that says a thing can be dragged — and nothing that does the dragging. | The containing component lacks drag behavior, keyboard operation, or an equivalent single-pointer path without dragging. | `bottom-sheet`, `side-sheet` | css-only |
| [Badges](../components/badges.md) | Attach counts or status to another item. | Interactive filters need chips; messages need feedback. | `chips`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Avatar](../components/avatar.md) | Identify a person or account by picture, initials or icon, alone or as a group of people. | A count or status on an icon needs a badge; an image that is the content needs media styles or a lightbox. | `badges`, `chips`, `lists` | css-only |
| [Tooltips](../components/tooltips.md) | Name or explain an icon-only control on hover and focus. | The icon already has visible text, or the tooltip would be the control’s only accessible name. | `icon-buttons`, `popover` | auto-init |
| [Popover](../components/popover.md) | Show a short note or a few actions on press, next to the button, until the user dismisses it. | A hint on hover or focus needs a tooltip; a choice of commands needs a menu; a task to finish needs a dialog. | `tooltips`, `menu`, `dialogs` | native |
| [Snackbar](../components/snackbar.md) | Brief, nonblocking feedback after an action. | Persistent issues need inline messages; decisions need dialogs. | `dialogs` | shared-runtime |
| [Progress indicators](../components/progress.md) | Measured progress or longer indeterminate waits. | Brief unknown waits fit loading indicator; instant work needs none. | `loading-indicator` | css-only |
| [Loading indicator](../components/loading-indicator.md) | Brief waits under about five seconds, no known fraction. | Measured or long-running work needs progress. | `progress` | css-only |
| [Skeleton](../components/skeleton.md) | Hold the layout of content whose shape is known while it loads. | A short wait with no known layout needs a loading indicator; measurable progress needs a progress indicator. | `loading-indicator`, `progress` | css-only |
| [Empty state](../components/empty-state.md) | Explain why a list, search or view has nothing to show and offer the next step. | An error after an action needs inline feedback or a snackbar; a loading view needs a skeleton or loading indicator. | `snackbar`, `skeleton`, `cards` | css-only |
| [Carousel](../components/carousel.md) | Browse a visual collection horizontally. | Dense comparisons need lists; enlargement needs lightbox. | `lists`, `cards`, `lightbox`, `marquee` | auto-init |
| [Marquee](../components/marquee.md) | Show a long, decorative set of logos, photos or short slogans in a small space, such as customer logos on a landing page. | People need to read, compare or act on the items; a list, grid or carousel lets them do it at their own pace. Time-sensitive alerts need a banner or snackbar. | `carousel`, `lists`, `chips` | css-only |
| [Lightbox](../components/lightbox.md) | Enlarge an image on activation. | Tasks need dialogs; browsing collections needs carousel. | `carousel`, `dialogs` | auto-init |
| [Toolbars](../components/toolbars.md) | Contextual actions; docked toolbars replace bottom app bars in new Expressive layouts. | Destinations need navigation; page identity needs app bar. | `navigation-bar`, `app-bar` | css-only |
| [Search](../components/search.md) | A search bar, and the view it expands into. | The field is ordinary data entry rather than finding content. | `text-fields`, `autocomplete`, `command-palette` | css-only |
| [Command palette](../components/command-palette.md) | Let people find and run any of many commands or destinations by typing, from anywhere in the app. | Searching content needs search; a few actions for one item need a menu. | `search`, `menu`, `dialogs` | auto-init |
| [Fieldsets](../components/fieldsets.md) | Name related form controls with a legend. | Visual content grouping needs cards or sections. | `cards` | css-only |
| [Text fields](../components/text-fields.md) | Enter or edit free-form text, numbers, or passwords. | The value comes from a constrained set better represented by selection controls. | `search`, `autocomplete`, `select` | css-only |
| [Rich text editor](../components/rich-text-editor.md) | Let people write formatted content such as posts, release notes or comments, and submit it as HTML with a form. | Plain text needs a text field; code or Markdown source needs a plain textarea. | `text-fields`, `toolbars` | manual |
| [Drop zone](../components/drop-zone.md) | Let people choose or drag in files where uploading is the main task of the view. | A form field that takes one optional file needs the compact file input. | `text-fields`, `cards` | shared-runtime |
| [Select](../components/select.md) | Choose one option, or several, from a styled menu. | A short option set should remain visible or free-form entry is required. | `radio-buttons`, `autocomplete` | auto-init |
| [Checkboxes](../components/checkboxes.md) | Turn several options on or off, saved by a later action. | The setting applies immediately or exactly one option must be chosen. | `switches`, `radio-buttons`, `button-groups`, `chips` | css-only |
| [Radio buttons](../components/radio-buttons.md) | Choose exactly one of a short visible set. | Several choices may be selected or compact direct manipulation is better. | `button-groups`, `checkboxes` | css-only |
| [Rating](../components/rating.md) | Ask for or show a score on a short fixed scale, such as one to five stars. | A continuous value needs a slider; a yes or no answer needs a switch or checkbox. | `radio-buttons`, `slider` | css-only |
| [Switches](../components/switches.md) | Toggle one setting that applies immediately. | A later Save action commits the choice. | `checkboxes` | css-only |
| [Slider](../components/slider.md) | Adjust a bounded numeric range. | Exact typed values need a numeric field. | `text-fields` | shared-runtime |
| [Chips](../components/chips.md) | Compact filters, tags, or contextual actions. | Passive counts need badges; primary actions need buttons. | `checkboxes`, `badges` | auto-init |
| [Autocomplete](../components/autocomplete.md) | Suggest values under a text field as the user types. | Suggestions are unavailable or the value must be limited to a small visible set. | `text-fields`, `select` | auto-init |
| [Date picker](../components/date-picker.md) | Choose dates or ranges in an inline calendar. | Simple entry may use native date; time needs time input. | `text-fields`, `time-picker` | auto-init |
| [Time picker](../components/time-picker.md) | Choose time in an inline clock. | Simple entry may use native time; dates need date input. | `text-fields`, `date-picker` | auto-init |
| [Questionnaire](../components/questionnaire.md) | Ask a short sequence of questions one per screen, such as a survey, an onboarding quiz or an intake form, where some answers are optional and later questions can depend on earlier ones. | People need to scan and correct many fields together; keep a single form with fieldsets. A few large stages with several fields each, such as a checkout, need a stepper. | `fieldsets`, `stepper`, `radio-buttons`, `checkboxes` | auto-init |
